header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا قَعَدَ قَوْمٌ مَقْعَدًا لَايَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ فِيهِ وَيُصَلُّونَ عَلَي النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا كَانَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً يَّوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَإِنْ أُدْخِلُوا الْجَنَّةَ لِلثَّوَابِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever sits in a gathering in which Allah is not remembered and Salawat is not sent upon the Prophet ﷺ, they will be filled with regret on the Day of Qiyamah (having lost reward because Dhikr and Salawat were not said), even if they enter Jannah because of their other good deeds!” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَة ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَامِنْ قَوْمٍ يَقُومُونَ مِنْ مَجْلِسٍ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ فِيهِ إِلَّا قَامُوا عَنْ مِثْلِ جِيفَةِ حِمَارٍ وَّكَانَ لَهُمْ حَسْرَةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد باب كراهية ان يقوم الرجل من مجلسه ولايذكرالله رقم:٤٨٥٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Those who get up and leave a gathering in which Allah is not remembered are like those who got up from beside a (foul-smelling) dead donkey. This gathering will become the cause of their regret on the Day of Qiyamah.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Gatherings are mostly never free from useless talk. That useless talk becomes the cause of punishment for the one who spoke it. However, doing the Dhikr of Allah in that gathering will save from the punishment.
(Badhl al-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَّكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ اَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ فَسَاَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِّنْ جُلَسَائِهِ:
